meta.purpose: Style token table for the Director floater UI kit, extracted from the approved HTML mockup. Every value below was read from the mockup source; none were invented.

other_sources.VCamPage.dc.html: VCam sub-page; NOT tokenised component by component (see meta.gaps)

meta.reference_image: mockup_ref/light_rig_mockup.png (screenshot of the Light > Rig page: rail with labels, tab strip, Easy/Advanced seg, Key/Fill/Back/BG chips, light map, Lights card, help pane, transport bar)
conventions: All px values are CSS px in the mockup's 1200x760 preview frame; the floater itself is 1160x720 by default and 850x560 at minimum.
Colour keys are lower-case token names. 'hex' is the literal string in source (upper-case as written).
Shadows and overlays are written as full CSS colour-function strings copied from source (black at alpha values .45 to .65).
'source' cites the primary file and line; a few values are only in Main.dc.html or Kit.dc.html and say so.
Dynamic style strings are built in the Director script (lines 882-2823). They are cited as 'Director.dc.html:NNNN' pointing at the builder line.
The verification script verify_tokens.py checks that every hex colour, colour-function literal and NNpx value in this file appears literally in the mockup sources.
gaps: VCamPage.dc.html has about 100 extra colours (scene render and preview art) and is only partially covered. Its chrome uses the same amber, grey and text tokens as Director; its scene colours are not tokenised.

Light-map scene art (Director.dc.html:450-470, 'rmBack*', 'rmFront*', globe gradients) is a runtime-computed diagram, not a UI component. Only the palette values it uses are listed, under colors.lightmap_scene.
Director has no literal row height for the dial and arc groups beyond the 48px dial; dial cell geometry is taken from line 1873.
ambiguities: Rail fold breakpoint: Kit.dc.html:82 says the rail folds to icons below 980 px window width; Kit.dc.html:103 table says 850-1099 px folds; Director uses isMin (850x560) only. Use the Director behaviour (fold at minimum size) and confirm the 980 threshold.
Card columns: Kit.dc.html:97-109 says cards drop to 1 column below 340 px; Director.dc.html:365 hard-codes repeat(2, minmax(0,1fr)) at every size.

Section header size: Kit uses 11px with letter-spacing .08em (Kit.dc.html:22, 60, 76); Director uses 11px .08em for the Cast heading and help kicker (Director.dc.html:142, 713) but 10.5px weight 500 .09em for in-card sub-headings (Director.dc.html:500). Both are in the mockup; the table records both.
Note colour: Kit 'Note 11' is #9BA3AE (Kit.dc.html:120); Director notes use #8A929D (e.g. Director.dc.html:142, 193, 265). Both are recorded.

Row geometry: Kit rows have no negative margin (Kit.dc.html:24 padding 8px 8px 8px 12px on the wrapper); Director rows use margin 0 -4px and padding 0 4px (Director.dc.html:1816). Director values are used.

IBM Plex Mono weight 600 is used for the REC pill (Director.dc.html:2795) and the 'NEW' badge font weight is 600 in Sans. The Google Fonts link loads Plex Mono 400/500 and Plex Sans 400/500/600 only (Director.dc.html:12). The 600 mono weight will fall back to synthetic bold unless Plex Mono 600 is added.
Shadow for the window uses rgba(0,0,0,.55) (Director.dc.html:2021); the Light/Rig card in Main uses no shadow. Director is authoritative.
Director.dc.html:2016-2017 sets the minimum floater to 850x560 at left 175, top 60; the default is 1160x720 at left 20, top 20.

loading_overlay.dialog: min-width 300px; max-width 460px; padding 22px 26px; gap 16px; bg #15171B; border 1px solid #2A2F36; radius 8px; shadow loading_dialog
loading_overlay.spinner: 26x26; radius 13px; border 3px solid #2F343B; border-top-colour #E8A33D; spin .9s linear
loading_overlay.title: 14px/600

menus_and_popovers.container: bg #15171B; border 1px solid #343A42; radius 6px; shadow popover or menu; padding 4px (menus) / 6px (scene menu, cast popover) / 10px 12px (legend)
menus_and_popovers.item: .res: background transparent; hover and focus-visible bg #262A31 (CSS line 41); item height 26px; padding 0 8px; radius 4px; 12px #E6E8EB; hint text 10.5px #8A929D

icons._note: All icons are verbatim copies of the inline <svg> elements in Director.dc.html. Files are in icons/. The stroke, fill, width, height and viewBox attributes are as written in source. Icons with {{...}} placeholders are runtime-computed parts of the light-map and dial art; they are copied verbatim with placeholders still in place.

reset_arc.svg.purpose: card header reset (also page reset at line 300, same geometry at 13px)

light_map_flip_side.svg.purpose: light map side-view flip button (sight/eye glyph with {{c.sd.*}} runtime transforms)

dial_compass.svg.purpose: compass dial face; {{dl.needleTf}} rotates the needle

not_extracted: Light-map scene art (Director.dc.html:452-470 full SVG scene, globe, beams and glyph groups). Only palette recorded in colors.lightmap_scene.
VCamPage.dc.html component styles (separate sub-page; extra scene palette of about 100 colours not tokenised).
Scene-menu and hotkey dialog internals (Director.dc.html:774-800, 863-880): geometry recorded only where it reuses menu/popover tokens.
